note: Per-machine reference values, not CI gates. Measured 2026-08-11 on Windows 11 Pro (powershell.exe 5.1.26200 / pwsh 7.6.4) with Invoke-DscCompileBenchmark.ps1 -Repetition 1 (median of 1 measured run after 1 discarded warm-up run) using the default inline xTestClassResource configuration (3 instances). builtin = inbox 1.1 on 5.1 / gallery 2.0.7 on PS7; fork = src module 3.1.0 resolved by name via PSModulePath. fork-fasthost parseSec is always 0 because Invoke-DscFastCompile does not expose a separate parse phase; its cold state clears the per-module user schema cache first, so cold includes live schema-cache generation.
